newsitem.title: GERMANY: Turkey's RAKS aims high with BASF Magnetics buy.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's RAKS aims high with BASF Magnetics buy.

text.p: Armed with recently acquired German tape group BASF Magnetics GmbH, Turkey's RAKS Holding A.S. intends to become a global leader in magnetic products, the group said on Wednesday.
"Our goal is to become a successful company comparable to Sony," RAKS head Aslan Oenel said told a BASF Magnetics in-house magazine.

BASF Magnetics GmbH, a unit of German chemicals giant BASF AG, is scheduled to be sold to the Turkish group for an undisclosed price, as the chemicals group streamlines its portfolio and concentrate more on core activities.
The deal was announced on August 15.
Oenel said the purchase of BASF Magnetics will raise its sales to 1.9 billion marks ($1.3 billion) from 400 million marks currently.
For the year 2000 the group plans income to be around two billion marks. ($ = 1.478 German Marks)
